seen_animation: A single popsicle drawn in black line (rounded-top bar, a short flat line across the base, a small tick mark at the lower right corner, a short rounded stick) hangs tilted about 30 degrees to the right, centred slightly left of the frame, over a grey perspective grid floor with three grey cloud outlines in the sky. In frames 1-10 nothing changes. From frame 11 thin grey vertical-line curtains enter from the left and right edges, and by frame 16 they have closed in to cover about a quarter of the frame on each side. The popsicle stays exactly the same drawing, in the same place, at the same angle in all 16 frames.
seen_film: A chocolate-coated ice-cream bar on a stick floats in front of a pastel sky with clouds above a checkerboard floor.
